name: Shanghai Kinetic Medical Co., Ltd
summary: Shanghai Kinetic Medical Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of medical devices in China and internationally. The company offers invasive spinal, invasive vertebroplasty, radiofrequency ablation, orthopedic trauma implant equipment, artificial organs, orthopedic surgical instruments, and other medical products, as well as surgical energy platforms and consumables. It is also involved in the provision of cleaning and sterilization solutions for medical devices, equipment, and medical and health materials and supplies; medical disinfection services; trading medical devices; technical consultation; after-sales technical service…
